dct_description_sm: Will be submitted to Remote Sensing of the Environment.

This data describes controlled release measurement data conducted under the Alberta Methane Emissions Program used to support calculation of the probability-of-detection curves and associated programs to analyze the data. The dataset also includes estimated environmental data from the high resolution rapid refresh (HRRR) database and the GOES-18 satellite to estimate technology availability over a calendar year.
dct_title_s: Probability of detection for airborne sensing of methane plumes using long wavelength infrared hyperspectral imaging
